title: Deferred worker lifecycle and QQ event routing
requirements: Runtime starts zero-argument worker factories only inside run, cancels and awaits all siblings before reverse resource cleanup on failure or cancellation.
Assembly creates no coroutine objects; feature background and registered workers use the same lazy factory representation without wrapper aliases.
QQ event routing is independent of composition, preserving notice handlers, group/private admission, quote enrichment and fault isolation.
Historical assembly/extension tests migrate canonical call sites without reducing assertions; no unawaited coroutine warnings are suppressed.
